content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not just about avoiding payment platform restrictions; it's about owning and controlling every aspect of your digital commerce stack, from storefront code to customer lists, order history, product files, and wallet addresses. With Core Merch's solution, digital creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, all without relying on Stripe or any other third-party payment processor. This includes the ability to integrate with 300+ cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, a fee of 0.5% per transaction, and no KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements or buyer account creation. In contrast, platforms like Stripe and PayPal impose strict KYC requirements, freeze accounts without notice, and charge exorbitant fees. But what about the actual costs and requirements for each option?
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's restrictions on certain countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, have left digital creators without a reliable payment solution. In contrast, Core Merch's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these restrictions altogether, providing a global payment solution that is available to digital creators in all countries, regardless of Stripe's policies. This means that digital creators can focus on building their businesses without worrying about payment platform restrictions or account freezes. But how do these options compare in terms of payment speed, fees, and real costs?
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, Core Merch's solution is unmatched, with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. The fee of 0.5% per transaction is also significantly lower than what Stripe and PayPal charge. But what about the real costs of each option? While Stripe and PayPal may appear to be free or low-cost upfront, they charge exorbitant fees on each transaction, which can add up quickly. In contrast, Core Merch's solution is transparent and upfront, with no hidden fees or charges. But what about ownership, automation, and delivery?
Digital creators can own their digital commerce infrastructure and achieve financial sovereignty with Core Merch's sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

This means that they can automate their business processes, including payment processing, product delivery, and customer communication, without relying on third-party services. But what about scaling and growing their business?

So how do digital creators choose the right architecture for their situation? The answer is simple: choose the option that provides the most financial sovereignty, ownership, and control. If you're a digital creator in a restricted country, or if you want to avoid payment platform restrictions and fees altogether, Core Merch's sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice.
